authority: main_implementation plan.md P08.1; api design.md sections 2.2, 3.9 and 14
context: The API inventory names queue and since filters but does not give this cross-project operational read a tenant selector. An unscoped global query would bypass the current organization membership and RLS model.
decision: Require an organization_id query parameter, resolve its tenant through server-side membership, and intersect the ops:read bearer scope with org_owner or org_admin. Counts run inside TenantUnitOfWork with RLS. Only the research_run queue is supported.
meaning: Queued, leased, overdue, completed and cancelled are current queue-row counts. Expired and retry attempts cover the since window, limited to 30 days. Fencing-failure count and worker status remain unknown because no durable measurement exists.
limitations: This is not a global operator dashboard, source-health proof, worker heartbeat or release readiness acceptance. Production/staging HTTP and alerting are pending.
